entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, there you are! Merry Christmas!
Merry Christmas.
I wanted to see you.
You didn't get lost?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Y-Yeah...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Today's kinda special, so... I feel[n]a little more nervous than usual.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Today's been... a lot. So I wanted to[n]see you too.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: For real though, I almost did.[n]Shibuya's way too crowded...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Okay, let's get down to business!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: First, we gotta get some roasted chicken.[n]I'm talking as big as me.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Okay, let's roll!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Waiiiit up. Uh, aren't you forgetting[n]something?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I mean, you're my boyfriend, so...
Let's hold hands.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Uh, yeah!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: W-Well... there ya go.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But don't grip it too hard, okay?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm kinda new to all this stuff, so...[n]as long as we take it slow...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Look, there are rules to this! Couples[n]gotta hold hands when they walk[n]around!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Aw, geez. Now you made me say it...[n]I'm all embarrassed...
